run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the minimum sum of two numbers formed from digits of an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correctness of the minimum sum algorithm
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which sorts an array and alternates elements into two numbers then returns their sum
review_f_gold: review f_gold to understand how it distributes sorted array elements alternately between two numbers
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to support returning the two individual numbers instead of just their sum
